stackDivergence.rationale: Task139 adds actual CntByteItem unsigned8 storage with native scalar narrowing, implicit copy/Clone, concrete payload equality ignoring Which and original Which/value hash through existing o3tl. Original Any query/put uses signed8, preserving255/-1 and rejecting non-byte Any without mutation through existing CPPU. SfxByteItem zero defaults and SvxPaperBinItem printer-settings255/default factory and concrete copy clones share the single base; actual Calc159 owned-item defaults are tested. No duplicated numeric engine, refcount/weak lifecycle, ABI/native memory or localized presentation fake. Original CntByteItem numeric presentation and SvxPaperBinItem EditResId presentation remain unported, as do real DocPool/document/UI/ODS. Existing metadata history/classification/status and deliberate I/O/recovery differences retained without whole-module parity promotion.
